# The Rhythm Outside

*For the first time, Drum plays the monster-rhythm outside the gate, on the Outworks' edge. Hunt the lampbats in the outer ditch while it plays, and see whether they scatter.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 60 [Lampbat](../monsters/lampbat.md) in [The Outworks: Outer Ditch](../maps/outworks_ditch.md)
